questions.question_text: Number of permutations of letters in 'APPLE':
questions.explanation: APPLE has 5 letters with P repeated twice. Total permutations = 5!/2! = 120/2 = 60, since identical letters reduce the count by dividing by the factorial of their frequency.

questions.question_text: Sum of first n natural numbers:
questions.explanation: The formula derives from pairing terms: 1+2+3+...+n can be rearranged so the first and last terms sum to (n+1), the second and second-to-last also sum to (n+1), and this pattern repeats n/2 times, giving n(n+1)/2.
